svg.title: Spa pavilions, floor plans
svg.desc: Herdade da Granja, floor plans of the spa pavilions. Footprints measured from José María's spa concept plan at his scale; interior fit-out indicative. Concept, illustrative. Norfront, 3 November 2026.
